summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for Flyboy Videography portal in the pre-SQL state (Supabase tables not yet created). All 9 pytest backend tests passed (health, auth guards on /api/clients/ensure and /api/admin/*, 503 SCHEMA_HINT on valid-token ensure, and static verification of supabase_schema.sql for review_update policy using author_user_id, invoices.currency default 'GBP', and invoices.client_id ON DELETE RESTRICT). No bugs found — everything behaves as spec'd for the pre-schema state.
